title: Zesty Garlicky Brazilian Cheese Fritters
description: These garlicky cheese fritters are a romantic Brazilian dish featuring nutmeg, perfect for a night in with someone special, and are also ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the crumbled queso fresco, minced garlic, and nutmeg, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, and milk to make a smooth batter.
Add the batter to the cheese mixture and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the cheese mixture into the hot oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
